title: Antisemitism and psychosocial health: Germany
sourceLabel: Shani, Goldberg, & van Zalk (2025), Supplementary Table S1
description: All ten variables and 45 unique correlations from the published table. The cross-sectional survey was collected in December 2022–March 2023. Full survey N = 420; a pair-specific N is not given in this table.
method: Pearson correlations and confidence intervals are transcribed from the publication, not recalculated or simulated. Pair-specific N and exact p-values are not supplied by this table. No individual-level distributions or condition filters are inferred from the matrix.
